authority: User explicitly requested merge branches, keep improvements and main as sole active branch; no production/deploy authorized.

criteria.target: Every local/remote branch inventoried with source disposition; all original refs recoverable from verified backup.
Selected improvements integrated without regressing existing main CI fixes; failed/unreviewed experiments preserved outside active branches.
Current integrated candidate passes applicable typecheck, lint, unit, PostgreSQL, E2E and CI checks; no gate weakening or inherited certificate.
Only main remains as local and remote active branch; linked worktree files and uncommitted deltas preserved and reconciled.
Shared root on main; evidence, runtime state, log and backlog reflect actual result.

remote_cleanup: old branches removed; main sole remote branch at checkpoint; temporary PR branch may be needed for current CI
